english.title: Parent neglect the cleanliness of his / her child a pupil at school
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) were the parent of a pupil, namely **(..SPECIFY PUPIL..), whose

(A)_[person]_
(B)_[clothing]_

had been cleansed under section 522 of the Education Act 1996 and afterwards

(C)_[became infested with vermin]_
(D)_[was in a foul condition]_

while the pupil was in attendance at a relevant school, namely **(..SPECIFY SCHOOL..), the condition of

(E)_[his person]_

(G)_[her person]_
(H)_[her clothing]_

english.legislation: Contrary to section 525(1) and (2) of the Education Act 1996.
